Container.Name: scan-stack-splitter
Container.Overview: Turns scanned paper into searchable PDFs, one per document, named by topic and date. The Stacks input splits large scans (hundreds of pages, no separator sheets) into documents by content. The Scanner input takes files from a document scanner, one document per file, and gives them the same OCR and naming. Uses Mistral OCR (batch API) and a Mistral chat model; the text layer comes from a fresh Tesseract pass. No web UI: progress is in the container log, and a review.md per stack in the Work folder lists uncertain splits. An optional third input only adds the text layer and uploads to Paperless-ngx. Optionally reports the queue to a webhook such as Home Assistant. Needs a Mistral API key.

Config.Name: Stacks
Config.Description: Large scans to split. inbox/, output/, archive/ and failed/ are created here.

Config.Name: Scanner
Config.Description: Scanner input, one document per file. Point the scanner's network-folder target at inbox/ below this path.

Config.Name: Paperless
Config.Description: Optional Paperless-ngx input (needs PAPERLESS_URL): files get the text layer and are uploaded to Paperless.

Config.Name: Work
Config.Description: Per-stack OCR text, plan.json, review.md and temporary page images (several GB while a large stack is processed). Holds full document text: delete stacks you no longer need.

Config.Name: MISTRAL_API_KEY
Config.Description: Mistral API key

Config.Name: MISTRAL_LLM_MODEL
Config.Description: Model for splitting and naming

Config.Name: MISTRAL_MAX_RPS
Config.Description: Requests per second, slightly below your account's limit for MISTRAL_LLM_MODEL (Mistral console: API > Limits)

Config.Name: TITLE_LANGUAGE
Config.Description: Language for document titles, e.g. German. Empty: the language of each document.

Config.Name: NO_DATE_LABEL
Config.Description: Used in the file name when a document has no date

Config.Name: OCRMYPDF_JOBS
Config.Description: CPU cores for the Tesseract text layer

Config.Name: PAPERLESS_URL
Config.Description: Optional: Paperless-ngx base URL, e.g. http://NAS-IP:8000. Enables the Paperless input.

Config.Name: PAPERLESS_TOKEN
Config.Description: API token of the Paperless user that should own the uploaded documents

Config.Name: PAPERLESS_TEXT_SOURCE
Config.Description: tesseract: Paperless content from the text layer (free). mistral: content replaced with Mistral OCR text, tables kept (about $1 per 500 pages).

Config.Name: PAPERLESS_TAGS
Config.Description: Optional: comma-separated Paperless tag ids to add on upload, e.g. 3,7

Config.Name: QUEUE_WEBHOOK_URL
Config.Description: Optional: POST queue counts here on every change and every 5 minutes, e.g. a Home Assistant webhook (http://HA:8123/api/webhook/ID). See the project README for the sensor config.

Config.Name: STACKS_TEXT_SOURCE
Config.Description: Text for splitting and naming stacks: mistral (Mistral OCR, paid) or tesseract (free, from the text layer)

Config.Name: SCANNER_TEXT_SOURCE
Config.Description: Text for naming scanner files: tesseract (free, from the text layer) or mistral (Mistral OCR, paid; worth it for handwriting or poor scans)

Config.Name: OCR_MODE
Config.Description: batch: half price, minutes per job. direct: immediate, full price.

Config.Name: FILENAME_PATTERN
Config.Description: {title} is required, {date} is YYYY-MM-DD

Config.Name: WORK_DIR
Config.Description: Keep at /work (the Work path above)

Config.Name: TMPDIR
Config.Description: Temporary page images go to disk instead of RAM
